description: Configurable POS loyalty points earned per unit sold, for a given product. Companion table to products — does not alter the existing products table, which stays fully owned by the products module. One active rate row per productId+companyId; companyId is auto-injected. Read server-side by sp_posRewardTransactions_earnFromTicket when a ticket is finalized — never trusted from the frontend.

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Product this point rate applies to.

fields.name: pointsPerUnit
fields.description: Loyalty points earned per 1 unit of quantity sold of this product.

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: When false, this product earns no points even if a rate row exists (kept for history instead of deleting).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
One rate row per product; UNIQUE(companyId, productId).

components.name: PosRewardProductRateField
components.description: Not a standalone page — this is a 'points per unit' number input + active toggle embedded inside the existing product create/edit form (ProductForm.tsx), saved as a second call right after the product itself is saved.

hints: UNIQUE constraint on (companyId, productId) — one active rate row per product per company.
action=1 must behave as an upsert: insert if no row exists yet for productId, otherwise update pointsPerUnit/isActive on the existing row (do not create duplicate rate history rows).

This table is read-only from the frontend's perspective for point calculation purposes — the actual points-earned math never happens client-side; see sp_posRewardTransactions_earnFromTicket in the posRewardTransaction PRD.
